Quests.Title: Timber for the Fold
Quests.Text: Ashgrove's folds need new fences before the wolves learn the old ones. Bring timber to the realm's quartermaster.
Quests.Done: The fences rise. The wolves will have to learn again.

Quests.Title: Stones for the King's Road
Quests.Text: Every road in Ostreval leads to the Old Throne, and every winter breaks a few of them. Bring stone to mend the way.
Quests.Done: Carts will roll a little straighter this week, and grumble a little less.

Quests.Title: Ore for the Ember Forges
Quests.Text: The forge-camps of the Ember Pass burn through ore faster than the hills give it up. Bring them iron ore.
Quests.Done: Halloran's smiths nod, which from Halloran's smiths is warm praise.

Quests.Title: Clay for the Kilns
Quests.Text: The kilns below the throne hill fire bricks for every house that pays. Today they need clay more than coin.
Quests.Done: The kilns roar. Somewhere, a wall will be a little warmer.

Quests.Title: Flax for Merrin's Nets
Quests.Text: Merrin's ferrymen mend their nets every dawn and swear the river eats them. Bring flax for the menders.
Quests.Done: The nets are whole. Merrin will find a way to charge you for it later.

Quests.Title: The Granary Tithe
Quests.Text: The realm remembers the hunger of the Long Thaw. Every season the granaries are filled before they are needed.
Quests.Done: The granary keeper chalks your name on the door. It is an old custom, and a kind one.

Quests.Title: Hides for the Tanners
Quests.Text: The tanners of Merrin's Ford will take any hide or pelt, and ask no questions about where it walked last.
Quests.Done: The tanners grunt their thanks and reach for their knives.

Quests.Title: Fletching for the Lists
Quests.Text: The Royal Tournament eats arrows, and arrows eat feathers. The Listing Field's fletchers are short again.
Quests.Done: The fletchers bind your feathers to shafts before you have finished counting them.

Quests.Title: Tallow and Bone
Quests.Text: Candles for the Hearth-keepers, glue for the bowyers. Nothing of a beast is wasted in Ostreval.
Quests.Done: The Hearth-keepers will read the Chronicle by your tallow tonight.

Quests.Title: Wolves at the Fold
Quests.Text: Halloran's shepherds count fewer lambs each dawn. Thin the wolves that prowl the edge of the Crown Wold.
Quests.Done: The folds sleep easier tonight, and so do the shepherds.

Quests.Title: Venison for the Hall
Quests.Text: A house that feeds its guests is a house that keeps its friends. Bring down deer for the long tables.
Quests.Done: The spits turn. Whoever eats tonight eats in your debt.

Quests.Title: The Bear of the Wold
Quests.Text: A bear has taken to the woodcutters' paths. The woodcutters have taken to staying home. Someone must go.
Quests.Done: The woodcutters return to the paths, singing louder than they need to.

Quests.Title: Small Game
Quests.Text: Not every hunt is sung about. Snare and shoot the small game that keeps a household fed through a hard week.
Quests.Done: The larder is full of small things, which is how larders are usually full.

Quests.Title: Thin the Wild
Quests.Text: The wild presses close to every hold in a new season. Push it back a little, beast by beast.
Quests.Done: The wild draws back to the tree line. It will return. It always does.

Quests.Title: Blades for the Watch
Quests.Text: The watch at the Tollbridge is down to two swords and a stern look. Forge weapons fit to hold a crossing.
Quests.Done: The watch takes your steel and stands a little taller at the bridge.

Quests.Title: The Fletcher's Day
Quests.Text: A bow without arrows is a stick with opinions. Fletch a quiverful for the realm's archers.
Quests.Done: The quivers are full. The archers pretend they were never worried.

Quests.Title: Smelting Day
Quests.Text: Ore is a promise; an ingot is a promise kept. Fire the smelters and pour the realm its iron.
Quests.Done: The ingots cool in rows like loaves. The smith counts them twice.

Quests.Title: Mason's Work
Quests.Text: Varrow's masons say a keep is only as good as its smallest stone. Cut blocks and slabs for the builders.
Quests.Done: The masons tap your blocks and listen. They ring true.

Quests.Title: The Carpenter's Bench
Quests.Text: Every hall begins as a tree and a patient carpenter. Saw lumber and planks for the realm's halls.
Quests.Done: Sawdust in your hair, lumber in the stack. An honest day.

Quests.Title: Shields on the Wall
Quests.Text: In the Long Thaw a hold was judged by the shields on its wall. Make one worth hanging.
Quests.Done: The shield goes up on the wall, and the hold looks sterner for it.

Quests.Title: Raise the Walls
Quests.Text: A house without walls is a rumour waiting to be disproved. Lay blocks and raise something that will stand.
Quests.Done: The walls rise. Let the realm come and look at them.

Quests.Title: Stone, Not Thatch
Quests.Text: Thatch burns and wood rots; stone remembers. Build in stone, as the Builders did.
Quests.Done: Merewin built in stone. So, today, did you.

Quests.Title: Timber Halls
Quests.Text: Not every house can afford a quarry. Timber halls have held good houses through bad winters.
Quests.Done: The beams are up. The hall smells of fresh wood and promises.

Quests.Title: Market Day
Quests.Text: The Crown Market's cobbles remember every price ever paid on them. Walk the stalls and be seen there.
Quests.Done: You did not haggle on the first stone. The traders noticed.

Objectives.Text: Spend active time in the realm, in minutes

Quests.Title: Pilgrim to the Hearth
Quests.Text: Every child of Ostreval is brought once to the Hearth and once to the throne. It does no harm to go again.
Quests.Done: The fire and the stone. You have seen both, and both have seen you.

Objectives.Text: Warm your hands at the Hearth

Quests.Title: Paid the Toll
Quests.Text: Carry word from the Tollbridge to Merrin's Ford. Whether you pay the toll is between you and your conscience.
Quests.Done: Both crossings saw you. Only one of them charged you.

Quests.Title: The Long Patrol
Quests.Text: The Stewards like to know the realm's places are still where they left them. Walk a patrol of three.
Quests.Done: Three places, all still standing. The Stewards will be relieved.

Objectives.Text: Visit named places of the realm

Quests.Title: The Watchman's Hours
Quests.Text: Somebody has to be awake when the realm sleeps. Keep watch, and keep moving while you do.
Quests.Done: The watch is kept. Nothing happened, which is exactly what a watch is for.

Quests.Title: Steel Tested
Quests.Text: A blade that has never been tested is a guess. Test yours against a foe of another house, or against the wild.
Quests.Done: Your steel has an answer now, instead of a guess.

Objectives.Text: Defeat a foe of another house
Or slay creatures of the wild

Quests.Title: A Signature on the Board
Quests.Text: The contract board at the Crown Market is never empty for long. Take a job and see it done.
Quests.Done: The board has one less contract on it and the realm one more honest worker.

Quests.Title: Answer the Herald
Quests.Text: When the Herald calls the realm to an event, the realm comes. Be there, and be part of it.
Quests.Done: The Herald saw you in the crowd. The Herald sees everyone in the crowd.

Objectives.Text: Take part in a realm event
